issue.title: Import Pillow lazily in tests/ace/tui/visual/conftest.py
issue.description: tests/ace/tui/visual/conftest.py imports Pillow at module import time, which forces just test and just test-cov to run the _setup-visual Justfile recipe even though those two lanes never execute the PNG visual snapshot suite. just test-scoped already avoids this cost. Making the Pillow import lazy (deferred into the fixtures/tests that actually need it) would let just test and just test-cov drop _setup-visual the same way. Carried from Tier 0 of the epic plan; proposed by epic sase-fp's land phase (sase-fp.8.3).
